context_title:
I have a court summons as a suspect for a pre-trial hearing tomorrow.
The paper says 120 minutes.
I’m not going to go, that’s 100%.

The last time, in December, they called me into the police station on a bogus reason, and there they told me that I’m not leaving from there anywhere — they’ll take me to prison if I don’t pay 400,000 HUF (it was paid). They said it was for not paying fake fines.
And I got NO paperwork saying I was banned from driving, and NO paperwork about the fines either.
And after they did this, a month later they sent the papers and admitted that I really hadn’t been notified.

On top of that, I have a very long, instructive history with the police; I attached everything.

This current case is the very first case that started in early 2021–22 (today is 2026-01-12).
Basically, all that happened was that on Grindr some old guy messaged me.
He was a pedophile piece of shit, but back then he transferred money so I would send pictures of myself.
Then one day I got fed up with him because he was aggressively harassing me saying he wanted to fuck me.
I had already blocked a lot of his profiles, then he wrote again.
I couldn’t think of anything else: I blackmailed him, thinking he’d get scared and leave me alone.
And he did — except the idiot actually transferred the lousy 10,000 — I repeat, TEN THOUSAND HUNGARIAN FORINTS.
Then he filed a report, and they’re seriously not dealing with the fact that he’s a pedo, but with the fact that I “blackmailed” him for 10,000.

So yeah, I’m not willing to waste a single minute of my life on this, and especially not risk it again in case they try to take me in or something.

It will be in Kalocsa; I live about an hour from there.
What kind of e-paperwork or whatever can I submit so I can sort it out quickly tonight so I don’t have to go, but they also don’t put out a warrant for me?

entries.answer:
What legal options or emergency steps exist in Hungary if I have a court summons as a criminal suspect for a pre‑trial hearing tomorrow in Kalocsa, I am 100% sure I will not attend in person, and I want to avoid that my absence leads to a warrant or being taken into custody?

Milyen jogi lehetőségeim vagy sürgősségi lépéseim vannak Magyarországon, ha gyanúsítottként kaptam idézést egy előkészítő bírósági tárgyalásra holnap Kalocsára, biztosan nem akarok személyesen megjelenni, és azt szeretném elérni, hogy a távolmaradásomból ne legyen elfogatóparancs vagy elővezetés?
